description: Read-only SQL (SQLite) over tables saved with store_as: SELECT or WITH, plus SHOW TABLES and DESCRIBE <table>. Returns at most 200 rows. Nested fields are flattened with _ (trend.direction -> trend_direction); booleans are 1/0. Tables are kept per API key and deleted 24 h after last use; format=csv returns CSV text.

format.description: csv: rows as CSV text. Default json.

name: query_data
